decisions.rationale: Add planned minutes for each module lab and a mutually exclusive day-block allocation showing which topic-page and lab minutes fill each F25-F27 activity, so no day exceeds its frozen block template. Do not compress honest topic budgets; narrow or integrate lab work instead, and report any overflow.

Map each of the two 15-minute coding tasks explicitly to the operations it elicits. Keep in the coding mapping only the objectives the tasks directly elicit (for example, move big-o-basics#o3 to a format that elicits it, or make the rewrite part of one task with a validated time fit).
Rewrite o1: predict duplicate handling and encounter order for given named implementations and code, distinguishing duplicate map keys from duplicate values. The List/Set/Map scope is unchanged.

Make the teaching and practice of iterator modification and ConcurrentModificationException explicit in the existing 'Lists, sets and maps in depth' topic before F28. That is teach-before-use inside an existing row, not new syllabus.
Narrow o2: List<String> lets the compiler reject adding a non-String in type-safe generic code and removes the read-side cast, while raw or unchecked code can still fail at run time.
Change o3 to 'changing fields that participate in equals/hashCode while the key is stored', with contrasting examples.

Name concrete implementations (ArrayList, HashSet, LinkedHashSet, HashMap, LinkedHashMap, TreeMap) in o1 and every prediction scenario, and test duplicate semantics separately from order. Applied together with education-3.

Bind the database-side half of the filtering/aggregation decision to version-pinned official PostgreSQL evidence: add it to the source snapshot, or bind to the equivalent frozen sql-jdbc-foundations evidence. State a bounded decision rule with examples.
